statement: The number 2 to the power 2026 multiplied by 5 to the power 2023 is written out in full. What is its last digit that is not 0?

choices.misconception: I gave the very last digit, which is 0, instead of the last digit that is not 0.
I found the last digit of 2 to the power 2026 alone and ignored the 5s.
I found the last digit of 5 to the power 2023 alone and ignored the 2s.
I paired the 5s with 2s correctly but then multiplied 2 by 3 instead of raising 2 to the power 3.

hints: Pair each 5 with a 2 to make a 10.
Each pair of a 2 and a 5 makes a factor of 10, which only adds a 0 at the end. Count how many 2s are left without a partner, and work out their product.
2023 pairs make 10 to the power 2023, leaving 2 to the power 3 unpaired.

solutions.reliable: Pair 2023 of the 2s with the 2023 fives: 2^2026 x 5^2023 = 2^3 x (2 x 5)^2023 = 8 x 10^2023. Written out, this is an 8 followed by 2023 zeros, so the last digit that is not 0 is 8. The transferable idea: factors of 10 only add zeros at the end, so strip out pairs of 2 and 5 before looking at final digits.

whyOnTest: Last-digit questions often hinge on 2 x 5 = 10; pairing the factors first shows the number is 8 followed by zeros.
